frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Visio et enregistrements
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Relier calendrier/tableau de bord a la visio et preparer l'acces aux enregistrements et resumes.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Real video provider can be stubbed by an embeddable placeholder while the join contract is stabilized.
Archive links can be mocked until archive-document-service phase.

frontTests.item: Student opens join page from calendar event.
Teacher opens join page for own session.
Recording list handles empty and expired states.

apiGatewayImpact.item: Allow provider callback routes separately if external callbacks are introduced.

definitionOfDone.item: A course event can lead to a joinable video session from the front.
Access restrictions are visible and tested.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
